content.short: InnMind connects Web3 startups with investors to raise VC funding.
content.description: InnMind is a leading deal-origination and data intelligence platform for Web3 and crypto entrepreneurs and investors. Founded in 2015 by Nelli Orlova, InnMind assists early-stage Web3 startups in finding the right investors and raising VC funding to develop and expand the decentralized web. The platform is designed for startups, investors, and service providers in the blockchain and crypto space, offering a comprehensive ecosystem of tools and resources. InnMind connects startups with investors through its curated network, providing access to funding opportunities, expert mentorship, and industry insights to fuel growth. InnMind also offers pitching sessions, providing startups with the opportunity to showcase their projects to a wide network of investors and industry experts, and hosts a knowledge base and document repository, serving as a valuable resource hub for entrepreneurs and investors.
